Dialogs.Dialog: (I came way too early... what now？)
I felt kind of restless today... could it be, you too？
Looks like it. Well, it's a little early, but let's go.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting！
Huh...... sorry. ...Right, maybe I was a little restless.
...Oh no. I'm like a little kid. Mm, let me take a deep breath？
(Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ here yet... there she is！)
(All right, let's give her a little scare. Sneak up quietly...)
Geez. That's someone else over there. ...I'll admit she does look a bit like me.
Were you looking forward to today so much you got flustered like that？
Hehe！ It's okay, I forgive you▼ Shall we go？
Guess I came too early. ...You seemed in a really good mood.
(We've both been looking forward to today's date. I get wanting to smile！)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting！ ...Huh？ Are you feeling okay？
▲主人公＊▲. No, I just had trouble sleeping last night. I'm fine.
Tell me if it gets bad, okay？
I'm fine！ I've been looking forward to this the whole time.
(All right, I'll make it. Plenty of time！)
I've come to pick you up... Just kidding. What a coincidence.
Really. We're so in sync we don't even need to meet up.
I was！ That's mean, sneaking up from behind.
No, I just got here... Geez, your clothes are all messed up.
Ah... haha, I rushed out because I couldn't wait. But you too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry for keeping you waiting.
It's fine, it's fine. Someone you know？
Yes, a neighbor. ...I was smiling so much that they got curious and talked to me.
Could it be that I... was like that from the moment I left home？ Oh no...
Hey, we still have time, so want to go get some tea？
We have time... so I was wondering if we could go into a shop somewhere.
Hmm... all right, let's do that.
Yeah, we have time, so let's get some tea.
Haah. This is fun, isn't it？
Yeah. And I've got high hopes for the rest of today too.
...For some reason, I just remembered White Day.
Hey, do you remember last Christmas？
Of course. It'd be harder to forget it.
Hey. Do you remember my birthday, the other day？
Even now, it suddenly comes back to me.
Hey, do you remember your birthday, the other day？
You have an "of course" look on your face.
...Hey, the other day... we celebrated the anniversary of when we started dating, right？
Don't you ever think back on it？
Happy I just picked a gift
...It's okay, really. I just want to make even more fun memories next time.
Memories... we've really made a lot, haven't we？
And we'll make more, for sure.
So many we can't carry all the albums？
So many we could build a house out of albums！
...Right... let's keep making precious memories, okay？ The two of us.
I was just thinking again... how much I love you.
Here, of all places... I'm happy, though.
...Seeing your face just now made me love you even more.
I wanted to make sure of our connection.
The memories in my heart... I wondered if they're in your heart too.
We have so many memories to talk about, I can't decide which.
Maybe so... And we'll keep making more.
Right. Today too... starting now. Hey, isn't that right？
I wonder what the future will be like...
I love you this much, and I'll love you even more... I wonder what happens after that.
I'm taking up... a lot of your time, aren't I？
I'm taking up yours too, so we're even, right？
Yes. Because Manaka's time belongs to you. ...Just kidding.
You were so cute back then...
Cute... ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s about the only one who says that, you know？
...You can't let anyone else say it but me.
Haha, nobody would. Don't worry, don't worry.
Really, you can't, okay？ It's only me...
There's still so much I want to talk about. There's not nearly enough time...
Today isn't the only time we can talk, right？
...Right？ We'll be together from now on too... forever...
Do you mind me going on about our memories like this？
Of course not. It's the history of the two of us.
I'm happy you say that. You treasure it as much as I do, don't you？
...I love you too, okay？ The more memories pile up... the more I love you.
We still get to be together today, right？
Or should I say, plenty more？
Because I still get to be with you... I'm really happy.
Yeah, me too. Let's have fun？
Is it okay to extend our time？
Of course, as long as you want.
Hehe. I'm looking forward to the rest of today？
Yeah. We still get to be together, right？
I think you could get even more excited, you know？
Really？ Then I'll take you up on that.
Even though we have the rest of the day？
Not nearly. Maybe I'm being greedy today.
I see. Then I'll do my best so you can enjoy it as much as possible.
We're still okay on time, right？
Want to stop by the park nearby？ I'd like to relax a little... Just kidding.
Mm, let's do that. Let's go.
Um, you know？ I was thinking I'd like to stop by the park... what do you think？
Yeah, sure. Let's take a little break.
Hey, there's a park up ahead, right？
Apparently, something good happens if you stop by.
Hey. Want to rest a little at the park nearby？
...That's not all, but is that okay？
Are we... still okay on time？
Um, you know？ Want to take a break？ At the park. Just for a bit.
Mm, okay！ Let's go, let's go.
Hey, want to stop by the park？
The park？ Sure, if you want to.
...I want to go to the park！
Hehe！ I made you say it. Shall we go？
Haah... Today was fun again, wasn't it？
Yeah. Not that there's ever a day that isn't fun.
We've been on so many dates, and not once？ Really？
Of course！ What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Really. ...Since I met you, there hasn't been a single day that wasn't fun.
Good work today. Did you have fun？
Of course. What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. So much, especially since we haven't had many dates lately.
Ah！ No, that's not what I meant！
Even if there are fewer, you treasure each one all the more, right？
Mm, just a little. I haven't been getting much sleep lately...
Because you ask me out so much and make so much time for us.
...Thank you. I feel a little relieved.
Mm... you haven't been asking me out much lately. ...I wondered if you were holding back for my sake.
No. I know it's not about how many or how few. I know you treasure our time together.
We moved around a lot today. You okay？
...Lately I've gotten used to feeling your warmth. If I don't do this, something feels missing.
Lately... we've had a lot fewer chances to touch like this, right？
I was anxious. Just a little. But now I get it. You were being considerate of me, right？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Why not come a little closer？
Ah... that's not it！ ...Lately, um... we've been kissing a lot, right？
And yet I still find myself wanting more... What if you came to dislike me for it...
...Being close enough to touch... it makes me nervous, doesn't it？
Lately... you've been holding back on kissing, right？
At first I wondered why... but that's you being kind too, isn't it？
Hey, don't you have any complaints？
Ah, sorry. There I go again...
You know, you always eat my cooking like it's so delicious...
Oh, so that's what you meant. It's always delicious, so I can't help it！
A relationship where you can say anything openly is nice, isn't it？
Yeah... what's this, all of a sudden？
You always tell me honestly what you think of my cooking.
Ah... sorry, I just say whatever I want.
It makes me happy, so it's fine. It motivates me too, you know？
Don't you？ You take so many pictures of me... so I thought so.
Now that you mention it... maybe？
Hey, are you the type who doesn't keep memories in physical form？
I wonder... um, what do you mean？
You don't take many pictures, right？ So I wondered.
I see... I hadn't really thought about it that much.
Good... so you weren't holding back.
Thank you for always accepting me.
What's this, all of a sudden？
My clothes, my hairstyle... you often compliment them, right？
When I think I'm matching your tastes... it makes me so happy.
...Having someone who accepts you is such a happy thing.
Mm... lately, I've often picked things that don't suit your taste...
Ah, clothes and stuff... does that bother you, by any chance？
No, not at all. It helps me understand you... I'm happier when you tell me straight.
I see. But it's not something you need to apologize for... sorry, okay？
When I looked at my recent email history on my phone, it was all your name, and I couldn't help laughing.
Because... when I think that the person I love thinks about me this much...
...don't you just end up grinning nonstop？
I reread the emails you send me sometimes...
Do I write anything amazing enough to reread？
The emails you send me once in a while are precious to me... they're my love letters.
You really know what I like, don't you？
When we go out to eat or have tea... you always put what I like first, right？
Yeah. Knowing my girlfriend is a given.
Ah, there's that smug face again. But it's true, isn't it.
You can be pushy sometimes, you know？
You, um... pushily touch me and such, right？
You're a little pushy, but I... don't mind it.
...It's because you're like that... that I want to be with you. Always... forever.
Let me stay by your side？ The closest to you.
...If someone like me is okay... I want you to keep me by your side, always...
I love you. More than anything. So...
It's because you're like that that I love you. I love you. I love you so much.
...Please give me the place beside you.
Even if you say no, I won't listen. Just kidding.
It's because you're like that... that I fell for you.
...It's because you're like that. I don't want to be apart. Not even for a little while.
Please, don't let go of me？ Ever...
...You know？ I want to be by your side, always.
You, who fell in love with me...
...It's because you're like that that I got so crazy about you.
Asleep or awake... it's all about you. ...No fair, it's always just me.
So... don't let go of me. Ever. Promise.
It's because you're like that... that I...
...Don't you know unless I say it？
...Geez. ...I love you. I love you so much. Let me stay by your side forever...？
I love you just as you are. I don't want to be apart from you, not even a little...
Saying something like this... might be shameless, but...
Please. Hold me tight... don't let go？
It's because you're like that... that I'm drawn to you.
Ever since we met... so much that even I can't stop it.
So, please. ...Let me stay by your side？ Lock me in your arms...
Don't send me home............ Sorry, it's nothing... I love you.
What do I do, I've fallen for you even more... If I'm a good girl... will you ask me on a date like today again？
I'm so glad I was born... that's not going too far, is it？ That's how happy I was today, how much I love you...
...Why do happy times always end in the blink of an eye？ I wish we could be together more, and more, and more...
The whole time I was with you... I was really, truly happy... I want to go on a date like this again... I'll be waiting...
The only one who can make me this happy... is you, after all. From now on too, always, make only me happy？
I don't want it to be over...... if I said that, it would trouble you, right？ Thank you, it was so fun... I was so happy.
Thank you for so much happiness today. I feel so content... I could just fall asleep like this. Hehe, silly, right？
Haah... hey, can I say it？ The best！ Just kidding. Hehe！
...I know it'll be a bother if I say this... but...
I still want to be with you.
I don't want to go home...
...I'll make do with this today. See you next time？
...Are you planning not to let me go home？
Geez. ...I wish time would just stop like this... Bye-bye.
...What do I do. I can't move anymore...
▲高嶺＊＊▲... I won't be able to let you go home.
You're the one who made me like this. ...Bye-bye.
...No, I won't be able to go home. See you.
I bet these will be gorgeous at night too.
Yes... but they're pretty in the evening too.
Yeah, cherry blossoms lit by the sunset... true.
Hey, how far do you think they'll light up the cherry trees？
It seems like a pretty big event, so I think we can expect a lot.
At night... will there be food stalls and stuff？
I wonder. I don't think there was anything like that.
...Hey, what kinds of stories or legends about cherry blossoms come to mind？
Hmm. Something scary buried under the tree？
There's that one, isn't there？ For me, a lot of them have a sad, wistful feel.
Seeing your own fate in the falling petals and feeling sad... remembering a lover and tearing up... But... that's changed.
To me, you're the sun. Just being near you warms my heart... You're like a sunny spot.
Next to someone like you, feeling you near while watching the cherry blossoms... I can't feel sad at all.
▲主人公＊▲, thank you. For finding me.
For falling in love with me. Thank you...
Look, over there. See the red berries？
Oh, there it is. Can you eat those？
It's used as medicine, so I suppose you could if you tried？ Want to try？
Yes, I think that's wise. ...You know, I love nanten.
The color when the leaves turn is so pretty... how they go from orange to red.
Huh... maybe I'll take a proper look sometime.
It's too late this year... so next year？
Next year, then. So, I'm counting on you to guide me！
Hehe, okay. I'm counting on you too▼
It looks pretty different lit up. Compared to the evening.
Lovely... but I think I like the sunset better.
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Weren't you looking something up on your phone earlier？
Ah, sorry. I just couldn't stop wondering...
Whether nanten berries are really edible.
Hahaha. So, what did you find？
You can eat them, but they're bitter and sour, so better not.
So somebody actually tried eating them...
Hehe. And, you know？ It listed what nanten means in the language of flowers...
Huh, it has a flower meaning？ What was it？
It surprised me. It felt like it had guessed exactly how I feel.
There's still a bit of time before it starts.
Want to have tea somewhere and read the pamphlet to prepare？
Hmm. But pamphlets sometimes have pretty important stuff in them, you know？
But surely they wouldn't print how the story ends？
Well, I guess that's true. Okay, let's do it！
...Hey, that wasn't the ending, was it？
It's fine, it's fine. It wasn't, probably.
(Please don't let that have been a spoiler！)
You'd never guess it was a first film. The director said it was really tough, though.
Yes. Making something from scratch is hard, not just movies.
Hey. If we were going to make something together, what would you choose？
Together... maybe sweets？ With ▲高嶺＊＊▲ teaching me.
Hehe, yes. We could do that right away.
What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Anything you want to make？
Me？ Um, sweets too, and cooking as well.
And then... ah, I'd like to try making a chair and table. With a cute design.
Right？ But what I want to make most of all is――a future with you.
Yes. So... don't ever let me go, okay？ I want to build our world together, by your side.
...Just kidding. Maybe I got swept up in the movie's final scene.
Then maybe I'll get swept up too.
Let's go, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Our adventure is just beginning！
They did！ Come on, let's go！ Here, your hand！
A bowling match against total strangers feels really fresh.
Yeah. And it's a serious match, too.
Let's win and get the prize！
Phew. It's the finals, after all. The other team's strong！
They're really good. They seem used to bowling.
We're making more little mistakes, so let's take it carefully？
...May your hand not hurt any more than this.
A good luck charm. I don't know if it'll work, though.
We did it, a come-from-behind win！
No, I'm happy？ But... maybe I'd rather have gotten the Lovey-Dovey Couple Award... Just kidding.
But if we'd won that, a photo of a kiss on the cheek would be at the front desk for a whole year...
Well, I'd have been fine with that！
I... I would. And the next one, and the one after that... I'd keep winning it forever...
Being in a place like this makes you lose track of time.
There are so many shops here, there's hardly enough time.
But it's so big, I bet you'd get tired fast.
True. And right then, something delicious-smelling wafts by.
Exactly. All right, let's take a break！
Agreed. What crepe should I get▼
Ah, can we go to the bookstore？
Sure. What are you looking for？
I want to look at some sweets books... and cooking books too.
...I never said a word about making it for you, you know？
Hehe, geez. Look forward to it.
Ah. Hey, isn't it about time？ For the illuminations.
Hm？ Oh, you're right. Let's go！
Yes... It feels like we're on the banks of the Milky Way.
I guess that would make it so？
Which means today is the one day a year we can meet.
Hehe. I'm glad the weather's clear.
If it rained, would you give up？
Mm... no. The me now would never give up.
The me before I met you would have given up. But now that I've met you...
When it comes to you, I've gotten really greedy. So I'd never give up.
And you？ Would you try hard for me？
Of course！ I can't lose to you！
Hey, look at this？ They're fighting.
You're right. Oh, these are a series. Let's see, next...
...It is. I want to see what happens...
The intensity right before she slapped him was something...
And he grabbed her hand, and they made up with a kiss in the end. Hehe, what a relief.
More than a relief, it's like, 'Thanks, I'm stuffed.'
That last photo looked so happy. Both of them smiling.
Showing it this way is interesting too.
Right... Oh, there's a lovely photo of a married couple？
Haah... The subtitle was "The World's Happiness, For You"... and it really was that kind of photo exhibit, wasn't it？
Everyone looking at them had their mouths all slack.
Hehe, the way you put that. You mean they were smiling, right？
Haha, right. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, which one did you like best？
They were all good, but... the one that stayed with me most was that one？ The sea otter photo.
Oh, floating in the water, holding hands...
Why do they hold hands, I wonder？ Is there a reason？
I think there must be？ But...
......I don't think you need a reason to hold hands with the person you love most in the world.
It's the same for them, I'm sure. Just like us.
The happiest I've felt all day...
We have a bit of time left, so let's have some tea.
Huh... ah, sorry！ I just saw the name and thought it sounded tasty...
Just wondering what ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would be like if she drank.
Like... well, when I was little, I had a sip of Papa's beer once...
Ah, the foam makes it look tasty.
Right. And then, I was apparently spinning around and around, singing songs.
Doing that would make you drunk in no time...
It was apparently a handful. I got all giddy. So I'd probably be like that now too？
Huh... say, how about we try...
No. That's for when we're adults.
There are all kinds of love songs, huh.
Yeah. They're not all happy ones.
Mm... hey, do you think a lot of those come from real experience？
Real experience, and maybe ideas from other people's conversations？
I see. Then someone might write a song about us someday？
Hehe, I'd kind of like to hear it. ...I want to keep creating all kinds of stories. With you, the two of us.
The kind someone just has to turn into a song？
Yes. ...And if possible, only happy ones.
Hehe. Ah, looks like the second half is starting.
Let's see. Snacks, drinks... maybe some real food too.
Well... with this much, of course it's hard. Spaghetti, gratin, katsudon, it all looks so good.
Hmm... let's get all of it！
Huh... we can't eat all that.
We can each have a little. We have time.
Then... I'll do that♪ Um, then...
We're running out of songs to pick.
...I wish I'd studied up a bit more too.
But your repertoire has really grown, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Both my repertoire growing, and singing like this.
...Hehe, I can't believe it. I used to think I didn't get what was fun about it.
So now you get why it's fun？
Yes, thank you. For showing me so many different worlds.
Right now, I want to sing. Just for you.
Yes！ Hold on, I'll search with all I've got.
Is there some event for 'Couples Day,' I wonder？
Looks like you get one extra credit on two-player games.
...Is this part of the special too？
I mean, every single result being good...
True. But maybe we can believe it？
I mean, look at us. There's nothing that could give a bad result, right？
No. I just thought you were right. It's my bad habit of getting anxious when results are too good or I'm too happy.
Sorry. Ah, hey, I want to try that game？
There seems to be a frame just for Couples Day.
You came out looking great too▼
Okay, split it in half, and...
......I hope we can take these every year.
No, nothing that formal. Just remembering, "Oh, it's that time," and picking out a frame together like this――
Before we know it, we'll be a grandpa and grandma. I think that would be wonderful.
But they'll probably be faded by then.
...That's okay. What matters is that you're by my side then.
Yeah... that's right. There. Here's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s half.
Thank you. Hey, shall we take another one with a different frame？
It's a mini live, but there are a lot of people.
Well――during their indie days, they broke attendance records at live house after live house. And now, armed with that legendary song, they finally make their major debut！
...That's the band. I think they have a huge number of fans.
Nice explanation. As expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Even though it's winter, I feel like I'm going to sweat.
The fans were really fired up.
Right. I might want some water...
Ah, I'll come with you. I want some fresh air.
You're the one who shoved me first!?
It wasn't on purpose！ You were the one slamming into me the whole show！
That's just how it is at a show！ THIS is what on purpose looks like！
Whoa... that surprised me... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you okay？
Phew, that surprised me... ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Don't do anything reckless, okay？
It was reckless. It's a good thing those two calmed down right away.
......When I thought you were going to get caught up in it... the words just came out on their own...
...I see. Sorry, that must have been scary. But thank you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
No. I'm sorry. I ended up making you worry instead. ...Did I manage to protect you？
(Next time, I've got to properly protect ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
People dancing, people selling paintings... anything goes.
Mm... hey, how does that thing move？
Look, that clown puppet. Bouncing up and down...
Isn't it hanging on strings or something？
But it's doing a full flip？
Hey, can we go look up close？
How reliable you are, Watson. Let's go！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so full of curiosity, really！)
Ah... is it already closing time？
Looks like it. We should get moving soon too.
When things are fun, it probably makes it feel even more that way. Ending, I mean.
"Fun and loneliness come as a set."
I've thought that ever since I was little. After something fun, loneliness is waiting.
Playing with friends, going on a family trip. When it's over, I end up alone. That's what I used to think.
Now that you're beside me, I'd forgotten I ever thought that.
Don't you get lonely after you go home？
...Still, it's different from the loneliness I used to feel, so I'm fine.
Let's go home？ Hey, I want to try one of those puppets.
Practice like crazy, then join in as a performer next time？
(So I've become a source of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s smiles... I'm glad.)
Today, why don't we go around the course backwards？
Oh. That's kind of a fresh idea.
Hey, was this building here before？ "Laser Athletics," it says.
All right, let's check it out.
Yeah. Makes me want to go for a high score. Another round？
Maybe there's an undiscovered attraction we haven't found yet？
I see. Then let's go find something else！
When I was a kid, an amusement park at night only felt scary.
The lights go out, everyone leaves... the whole thing becomes a haunted house？
Yeah. And now it's a dream world like this.
Really. It's amazing how much a little lighting changes everything.
Because I feel like you being here is what lets me shine.
Will you keep shining on me forever？
Sorry in advance if my battery dies partway, okay？
If that happens, I'll recharge you, so don't worry？
...It's a land of dreams, after all.
Then I'd better change jobs too. What should I be？
So, something like that？ Wait, you answered instantly？
Haha. Then I'll be exclusively ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s.
Don't you think the staff and clerks get sick of it？
But there might be... some people who feel happy seeing us. Maybe. Possibly.
Point is, the best thing is for us to have fun. Looks like there are some events only today, too.
Mm. Hey, what kind of events are there only today？
A small one is "Synchronize de Silly Couples."
The main one is this！ "Hug Me, Honey！ Up Close and Personal in Swimsuits"！
What's with you, all of a sudden？
Because... it's really nothing but couples. Inside and out. It's a sight you don't get to see often.
True... well, we're one of them, after all.
Yes. Just watching makes me embarrassed...
If we did that too... maybe we wouldn't be embarrassed anymore.
Otherwise, I'll want to run away from here...
Hey, I wonder what kind of movie it'll be.
Since they're showing it here, maybe something that uses the whole screen？
Hmm... hehe, no good. I can't picture it at all.
We didn't buy drinks and popcorn.
I'll go buy them. What do you want to drink？
Um, I'll have the same as you.
Same as me. Be right back.
Wrong？ I was sure of it, too. Too bad.
Heh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ still has a ways to go...
You're right. You can see them well today. But that means it's co... achoo！
Hey, is that bright one Venus？
Yeah, probably. Judging by where it is.
Hey, try reaching your left hand toward the stars？
Stretch your fingers out like that... a little higher... there.
Hehe！ A lovely ring, all done▼
A star ring, huh... I see？
Ah... but men's rings usually don't have stones, do they？
Oh, maybe not. Then this one doesn't count.
The ring that suits your finger... let me pick it out, okay？
Okay. Shall we take a leisurely look around？
Hey. Is that the viewing area over there？
Looks like it. ...I guess we can't go in yet.
There's still plenty of time until it starts.
If we could get in... were you planning to wait there the whole time？
I wanted to watch with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ from a good spot.
Even though we don't know where the fireflies will fly？
Hehe！ Just spending time in the same place with you makes me happy, you know？
Well, same here, but？ I guess I got a little greedy...
Yes. You thought that for my sake, right？
...Thank you. I'm happy. I hope lots of them fly over to us！ The fireflies.
Fireflies... it's my first time seeing this many...
Yeah. We'd better talk quietly, or they might fly off.
With fireflies, both males and females glow, but the males glow brighter, you know？
I was only giving off a faint light... and you were the first to answer with a strong one. I was confused at first... but I was happy.
Look, over there. A male is flying over to a female.
Which means those two will be happy too. Yep.
Hey. There's pair skating and ice dancing, but what's the difference？
Hmm？ They seem about the same to me...
Geez. But we'll know when we see them, right？
Aren't you curious about this 'synchronized skating' too？
